ota_recommendation: With 1800KB app size and 4MB flash, dual OTA partitions are feasible (2×2048KB layout).
summary: The ESP32-C3 has sufficient memory for the ESP-Matter application, with approximately 43.9% of flash and 45.0% of DRAM used. Top optimization wins include enabling compiler size optimization, enabling newlib nano format, and disabling unused Matter clusters, which can save an estimated 95KB of memory.

release.changelog:
# CHANGELOG for v73 - esp32c3
## ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol over Wi-Fi and Ethernet
* Implemented device provisioning using QR code scanning
* Introduced a new API for custom device firmware updates

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed a bug causing occasional Wi-Fi disconnections in AP mode
* Resolved an issue with incorrect timestamping in device logs
* Corrected a problem with incomplete data transmission over UART

## 🔐 Security
* Identified 1 potential secret in the codebase, which will be addressed in the next release
* Confirmed 0 critical CVEs affecting the current firmware version
* Started reviewing the codebase for potential security vulnerabilities

## ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash memory usage, now at 43.9% capacity
* Identified potential savings of 95 KB in flash memory
* Improved device boot time by reducing unnecessary initialization steps

## 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated 4 new tests to improve code coverage and ensure functionality
* Began reviewing code for adherence to esp-idf coding standards
* Started using AI-powered tools to detect potential issues and improve code quality

## ✅ Quality Gates
* Successfully passed the build process with no errors
* Confirmed that all required tests were executed and passed
* Verified that the firmware image can be successfully flashed to the device

## ⚠️ Known Issues
* The security score is currently 0/10, indicating a need for significant improvement
* The presence of 1 potential secret in the codebase poses a security risk
* Some features may not be fully optimized for low-power consumption

## 🔜 Next Release
* Address the identified security vulnerabilities and secrets
* Apply AI-generated patches to improve code quality and performance
* Focus on improving the overall security score and reducing potential risks
